sourcePolicy.note: This repository stores rule identifiers, implementation summaries, provenance, and official source links. It does not reproduce complete copyrighted code books.

adoptedCodes.title: Texas Air Conditioning and Refrigeration rules
adoptedCodes.authority: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
adoptedCodes.note: Texas updated adopted ACR reference codes from 2021 editions to 2024 IRC, IMC, IFGC, and UMC effective September 1, 2026.

adoptedCodes.title: International Residential Code
adoptedCodes.authority: International Code Council / Texas TDLR adoption

adoptedCodes.title: International Mechanical Code
adoptedCodes.authority: International Code Council / Texas TDLR adoption

adoptedCodes.title: International Fuel Gas Code
adoptedCodes.authority: International Code Council / Texas TDLR adoption

adoptedCodes.title: National Electrical Code
adoptedCodes.authority: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
adoptedCodes.note: Texas adopted the 2026 NEC as the state electrical code with a limited Texas modification related to GFCI requirements for certain outdoor outlets/equipment.

rules.title: Texas ACR adopted-code baseline
rules.summary: Use the 2024 IRC, IMC, IFGC, and UMC editions adopted by Texas for ACR work from September 1, 2026, subject to applicable local amendments and authority having jurisdiction requirements.

rules.title: Heating and cooling equipment sizing
rules.summary: Equipment sizing follows an approved equipment-selection methodology based on approved building heating and cooling load calculations; square footage alone is not a compliant sizing method.
rules.implementationNote: The calculator must not infer tonnage from floor area alone. Future room/load workflow should collect inputs needed for a load calculation or require an approved load result.

rules.title: Appliance installation / listing and manufacturer instructions
rules.summary: HVAC appliance installation must follow applicable listing, labeling, and manufacturer installation instructions. Equipment-specific details must not be invented by the calculator.

rules.title: Condensate disposal
rules.summary: Cooling-coil and evaporator condensate must be conveyed to an approved disposal point using an installation that satisfies the adopted drainage requirements.

rules.title: Auxiliary / secondary condensate protection
rules.summary: Where primary condensate overflow or stoppage could damage building components, provide an allowed auxiliary or secondary protection method and verify the selected method with the local AHJ.

rules.title: Condensate pumps
rules.summary: When a condensate pump is used, verify the adopted requirements for pump installation and any required failure interlock based on location and installation conditions.

rules.title: Texas 2026 NEC baseline
rules.summary: Electrical HVAC checks use the Texas-adopted 2026 NEC baseline. Equipment nameplate, listing, branch-circuit, disconnect, GFCI, and local AHJ requirements must be verified for the actual equipment and installation.

rules.title: Local authority having jurisdiction verification
rules.summary: State and model-code references are not the final local answer. Verify city, county, permit-office, and AHJ amendments or interpretations that apply to the actual project location.
